implemented_slice.purpose: Prevent a zero-result connector snapshot from being promoted to exhaustive exact-commit deployment evidence.

cases: connector snapshots cannot self-declare exhaustive coverage

limits: The connector action exposes pull-request-triggered runs from the first page only.
No immutable Vercel deployment identity was established.
No browser or physical-device audio verification was performed.
Exhaustive evidence still requires authenticated all-event pagination through the Frontier enumerator.
